name: markdown-pass
why: Removing backticks and asterisks leaves the exact path.

name: markdown-near-miss
why: Cleaning cannot remove the adjacent letter suffix.

name: slash-pass
why: Backslashes normalize to forward slashes.

name: slash-near-miss
why: Slash cleaning cannot remove the letter suffix.

name: whitespace-pass
why: The whitespace run collapses to one space.

name: whitespace-near-miss
why: Whitespace cleaning does not stem a plural.

name: case-pass
why: Literal comparison ignores ordinal case.

name: case-near-miss
why: Ignoring case does not remove a letter suffix.

name: left-letter-pass
why: A digit beside a letter endpoint is allowed.

name: left-letter-near-miss
why: A BMP letter before the letter endpoint splits a letter run.

name: right-letter-pass
why: A digit after a letter endpoint is allowed.

name: right-letter-near-miss
why: A BMP letter after the letter endpoint splits a letter run.

name: left-digit-pass
why: A letter beside a digit endpoint is allowed.

name: left-digit-near-miss
why: A BMP digit before the digit endpoint splits a digit run.

name: right-digit-pass
why: A letter after a digit endpoint is allowed.

name: right-digit-near-miss
why: A BMP digit after the digit endpoint splits a digit run.

name: later-occurrence
why: A later occurrence can pass after an invalid first digit boundary.

name: overlapping-occurrence
why: The overlapping later occurrence has valid punctuation boundaries.

name: decimal-gap
why: The literal digit rule permits a decimal suffix after punctuation.

name: quote-gap
why: Curly quotes are not converted to straight quotes.

name: underscore-gap
why: Underscores are not whitespace.

name: guard-pass
why: The positive value appears without the forbidden value.

name: guard-near-miss
why: A positive match with a forbidden match fails.

name: positive-precedence
why: A missing positive match takes precedence over the forbidden guard.

name: no-answer-precedence
why: Whitespace answers are unavailable before positive or guard matching.
